messages:
harshita_csm: Quick heads-up — Asteria Labs onboarding health check. They reported perf blips during bulk ingest yesterday. Their contract SLO is 99.9% uptime and p95 latency 300ms. Current 30d: uptime 99.4%, p95 420ms. CFO at Asteria is asking about renewal risk and whether we owe credits. Need SLO evidence + a proposed credit calc for their renewal packet by EOD Friday. Can @maria_cs / @jon_sre / @devon_platform take ownership? 

ops_bot: Automated SLO summary for project=asteria-labs (30d window): uptime=99.42% (SLO=99.9%), p95_latency=420ms (SLO=300ms), incidents=2 (major=1), last_incident_ts=1786001122. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/asteria-labs/slo-report

maria_cs: Acknowledged. I'll own the customer comms + one-pager once we have numbers. Question: do we include rolling 90d or 30d? Legal usually expects 30d for onboarding credits. @jon_sre? 

jon_sre: 30d is fine for onboarding evidence. I'll grab the incident timelines and RCA. Initial note: both spikes align with bulk ingest jobs on ded-3 in us-west2. Suspect KV-cache thrashing during parallel sessions. 

devon_platform: Confirmed, Asteria is on Dedicated pool ded-3 (reserved). I'll pull traces and request kernel traces from runtime. Quick query I'm running to calc downtime minutes:
```
SELECT
  SUM(downtime_minutes) as total_downtime
FROM uptime_events
WHERE customer='asteria-labs' AND window_start > '2026-02-01'
```
Will paste results here in ~20m.

maria_cs: For the credit calc: our policy is tiered — <99.9 && >=99.5 => 5% service credit, <99.5 && >=99.0 => 10%, <99.0 => 25%. If we land at 99.42% it's in the 10% bracket per policy? Wait check table above — I'm fuzzy. @jon_sre can you confirm which bracket applies given our documented policy? 

jon_sre: Policy check — legal_sla_table.pdf says: 99.9-100: 0%, 99.5-99.9: 5%, 99.0-99.5: 10%, <99.0: 25%. So 99.42% -> 10% credit. I'll attach the excerpt.

harshita_csm: That's... going to be material for renewal. Let's explore mitigation + optional partial credit offset: can we propose a one-time onboarding credit of 7.5% to show good will? Or does CS only present policy numbers? 

maria_cs: We can propose a compromise in the renewal deck but must mark as 'proposed, subject to legal approval'. I'll draft two options: policy credit (10%) and compromise credit (7.5%). Harshita can decide which to pitch. 

devon_platform: Traces done: found two ingestion batch windows where p95 jumped to ~900ms for 6–8 minutes due to KV cache eviction storms. Patch candidate: reduce parallelism for ingestion workers + bump cache capacity on ded-3. ETA for patch to staging: 48h. 

jon_sre: RCA note: root cause linked to parallel GC and cache resizing on the dedicated pool during high concurrency. Mitigation steps per eng runbook: 1) throttle ingestion jobs, 2) apply cache hotfix, 3) schedule canary rollout, 4) monitor p95. I'll produce a short RCA doc. 

harshita_csm: Next steps / owners:
- Maria: draft customer-facing one-pager w/ credit options + timeline (due: Fri 18:00 PT) 
- Devon: provide patch PR + staging rollout notes (due: Wed EOD)
- Jon: incident timeline + legal SLA excerpt (due: Thu noon)
- Harshita: align on pitch + finalize compromise (due: Fri noon)

maria_cs: I'll also request a transcript of support chat and attach per-account evidence bundle. Also want voice of customer note: they mentioned enablement gaps around onboarding docs for bulk ingest. Harshita — can you capture feedback and propose a short enablement session? 

harshita_csm: Yes — I'll offer a 45-min enablement + runbook walkthrough with their infra team next week. I'll take notes and add to the renewal risk section. 

devon_platform: FYI here's the quick command I used to pull p95 per hour for the last 30 days:
```
select date_trunc('hour', ts) as hr, percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by latency_ms) as p95_ms
from request_metrics
where customer='asteria-labs' and ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
group by hr
order by hr desc
```

ops_bot: Watchlist updated: asteria-labs -> renewal-risk=medium (auto-tag due to uptime < SLO). Added note: 'CS outreach initiated' by harshita_csm. 

jon_sre: I'll attach the incident IDs and timeline here once the RCA doc is ready. For credit calc confirmation: legal sign-off required before we commit numbers in writing. 

maria_cs: Understood — we'll show both numbers as 'policy' vs 'goodwill' in the deck and say 'pending legal approval.' 

harshita_csm: Thanks team. I'll run this as a sync on Friday 11:00 PT if needed. Please drop artifacts in the thread (dashboards, RCA, support transcript). :thumbsup: 

maria_cs: Dropping initial doc skeleton: https://drive.redwood/asteria-slo-onepager/draft-v1 (will update). 

devon_platform: Patch PR created: https://git.redwood/infra/patches/4521 — awaiting review. 

ops_bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up reminder in 48h for owners. 

jon_sre: +1 — adding to my calendar. 

harshita_csm: closing loop for now. If anyone needs extra context ping me. :bow:
